creator: Alexander Terp
description:
rad still carries its own runner loop in `core/testing`, plus three suites that
reuse it by smuggling their domains through mismatched fields (AST in Stderr,
checker dumps in Stdout). That duplication is the whole reason go-snap exists.

The LSP suite is already ported and green (105 cases, zero snapshot churn) on
branch `try/go-snap` in the rad-gosnap worktree. These four are the bigger job:
each needs its output channels renamed to what they actually are, which means
touching every .snap file in the suite, not just the harness.

Done when rad's `core/testing` package is deleted and all suites run on go-snap
with no snapshot content changes beyond the channel renames.
title: Port rad's remaining snapshot suites onto go-snap
